ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ICICI Life Insurance Limited announced a material leadership transition, with Mr. Anup Bagchi resigning as Managing Director and CEO, effective October 13, 2026, to pursue new career opportunities. The Board has appointed Mr. Sidharatha Mishra, from ICICI Bank with 26 years of banking experience, as the new Chief Operating Officer (COO) from October 6, 2026, and subsequently as the MD & CEO from October 14, 2026, subject to regulatory approvals. This appears to be a planned succession from within the broader ICICI Group, indicating a smooth handover with no immediate red flags, despite the new CEO's primary background being in banking.
